name: psychopfad-wien
description: Selbstlern-App zum Bachelorstudium Psychologie an der Universität Wien

scripts.test: npm run test:data && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/pwa.mjs && node tests/native.mjs && node tests/backup.mjs && node tools/build.mjs && node tests/artifact.mjs
scripts.android:add: node tools/build-web.mjs --android && cap add android && capacitor-assets generate --android && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('android/app/src/main/res/drawable',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('assets/notification-icon.xml','android/app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_stat_psychopfad.xml')"
